full_prompt_en: An extreme photographic close-up fills the square frame with a face covered in vivid, irregular pigment. Both gray-green eyes are fully visible near the upper edge, looking outward beneath dark lashes and partially cropped brows. The bridge and rounded tip of the nose occupy the centre, while textured red lips sit near the bottom. Natural skin remains visible around the mouth and across small gaps in the paint. A dense blue-teal area spreads across the left cheek and the space below the left eye. Magenta, red, orange, and golden-yellow strokes cross the forehead, bridge of the nose, and opposite cheek in broken bands. Smaller turquoise flecks and uneven pigment deposits interrupt the warm colors. Some patches appear dry and granular, while others catch tiny moist highlights. The lips carry a deeper red upper contour and a softer pink sheen below. Soft frontal light models the nose, eyelids, and cheeks, revealing pores and pigment grains without erasing the underlying facial structure. Darker areas around the eyes and beside the nose provide local contrast. The crop excludes most of the hair and surrounding environment; only narrow peripheral slivers remain beyond the face. Rather than following natural shadow boundaries, the applied colors form a separate, tactile layer over the skin. The close framing makes differences between smooth skin, coarse pigment, and reflective highlights especially prominent. Warm yellow-orange and magenta collide with cool teal and blue, producing an intense, direct portrait anchored by the clear eyes and recognizable features.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅摄影极近景，鲜艳而不规则颜料覆盖的面孔几乎填满方形画面。靠近上缘的两只灰绿色眼睛完整可见，在深色睫毛和部分被裁切的眉毛下向外凝视。鼻梁与圆鼻尖居于中央，带纹理的红色嘴唇靠近底部。口周以及颜料间少量空隙仍露出自然肤色。浓密蓝绿区域铺过左脸颊及左眼下方，洋红、红、橙与金黄笔触以断裂色带横过额头、鼻梁和另一侧脸颊。较小青绿斑点和不均匀颜料沉积打断暖色区域。部分色斑干燥而颗粒明显，另一些则接住细小湿润亮光。上唇轮廓更深红，下唇带柔软粉色光泽。柔和正面光塑造鼻子、眼睑和脸颊，显出毛孔及颜料颗粒，同时保留底层面部结构。眼周与鼻侧暗部提供局部反差。紧密裁切排除了大部分头发和环境，脸外只剩极窄边缘。涂覆色彩并不依循自然阴影边界，而是在肌肤上构成独立、有触感的一层。近距离画框放大光滑肌肤、粗颜料和反光亮点的差异。暖黄橙与洋红碰撞冷青蓝，形成强烈而直面观者的肖像，由清楚双眼与可辨五官稳定画面。
style_prompt_en: Tactile pigment and finely resolved tonal modeling combine in a vivid, closely framed treatment. The visual treatment favors vivid color blocks, granular texture and strong local contrast. Warm reds and yellows meet cool blues, teals and violets in irregular patches rather than smooth natural gradients. Dark areas hold the composition together, while pale highlights punctuate the saturated fields. Edges can break into small flecks or layered marks, creating a layered, materially varied surface. Close framing intensifies the color relationships, and the focal area remains sharper than the surrounding edge. The effect is bold and expressive, driven by chromatic collisions, uneven texture and tight visual concentration.
style_prompt_zh: 可感颜料质地与精细明暗塑形结合，形成鲜明而紧凑的画面处理。这种视觉处理偏向鲜艳色块、颗粒质感和局部强反差。暖红、黄色与冷蓝、青绿、紫色以不规则斑块相遇，而非平滑自然渐层。深色区域稳定构图，浅色高光则点亮饱和色域。边缘可以碎裂成细小斑点或层叠笔触，形成层叠而材质有变化的表面。紧密裁切强化色彩关系，焦点区域比周围边缘更清晰。整体效果大胆且富表现力，来自色相碰撞、不均匀肌理和高度集中的视觉布局。
theme_en: An extreme photographic close-up of a face with both eyes visible beneath vivid painted pigment
theme_zh: 面孔的摄影极近景，双眼完整可见，鲜艳颜料覆盖肌肤
name: Flashy colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
